title: Salesforce Zendesk Integration: A Setup Guide for 2026
summary: Salesforce Zendesk integration enables support and sales teams to synchronize customer data across platforms. You can choose the right automation tools.
body_markdown:
## Troubleshooting common Salesforce and Zendesk sync errors


Reliable Salesforce and Zendesk synchronization requires addressing the hard technical constraints of each platform’s API. You can't treat the connection as a simple "set and forget" toggle.


Hitting a documented platform ceiling or a data structure mismatch is almost always the cause when a sync fails. It's rarely due to a logic error in the workflow.

### Resolving Salesforce API Request Limit Exceeded errors


Salesforce enforces strict daily limits on the number of API calls an organization can make. This means a high-volume Zendesk sync can inadvertently lock out other business-critical integrations.


The integration has consumed the total allocation for the 24-hour rolling window if you receive a` REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` error. **To resolve this, you must transition from a "polling" architecture to a webhook-based architecture using Salesforce Outbound Messages or Change Data Capture.**


This shift ensures that an API call is only consumed when an actual record change occurs. This prevents the sync from wasting the budget on empty checks.


### Fixing Zendesk 'invalid field' mapping errors


Zendesk will reject incoming data payloads if the field types or character limits don't align perfectly with the target attributes in the Ticket or User object. A common failure point occurs when attempting to sync Salesforce` CaseComments` into Zendesk.


The comment body is simply truncated if it exceeds the 64kB limit enforced by Zendesk, rather than causing the API call to fail. To fix these errors, audit the field types to ensure a Salesforce "Picklist" is mapping to a Zendesk "Drop-down" with identical internal tags.


Implement a truncation script in your middleware to cap text strings at the maximum character count allowed by the destination field. Verify that "Required" fields in Zendesk aren't receiving null values from Salesforce, which triggers a validation error that halts the sync.


### Fixing Salesforce Zendesk OAuth token expiration errors


Authentication failures occur when the secure handshake between the two platforms is interrupted. This is typically due to the expiration of the OAuth 2.0 refresh token.


April 2027 is the definitive deadline set by Salesforce to retire older authentication methods in favor of enhanced JWT (JSON Web Token) flows. Any integration relying on legacy username/password strings will cease to function.


To maintain uptime, you must configure your integration to use a "Refresh Token" flow. This allows the system to request a new access token automatically without requiring a manual login from an administrator every time the session times out.
